      "content": "from datetime import datetime\nfrom sqlalchemy import Column, Integer, String, Text, REAL, ForeignKey, DATETIME, CheckConstraint, UniqueConstraint\nfrom database import Base\n\nclass User(Base):\n    __tablename__ = \"users\"\n\n    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True)\n    username = Column(String, unique=True, nullable=False)\n    full_name = Column(String)\n    email = Column(String, unique=True)\n    created_at = Column(DATETIME, default=datetime.utcnow)\n    updated_at = Column(DATETIME, default=datetime.utcnow)\n\nclass Program(Base):\n    __tablename__ = \"programs\"\n\n    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True)\n    name = Column(String, nullable=False)\n    term = Column(String, nullable=False)\n    created_at = Column(DATETIME, default=datetime.utcnow)\n    updated_at = Column(DATETIME, default=datetime.utcnow)\n\n    __table_args__ = (UniqueConstraint('name', 'term'),)\n\nclass Applicant(Base):\n    __tablename__ = \"applicants\"\n\n    id = Column(String, primary_key=True)\n    program_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey(\"programs.id\"), nullable=False)\n    first_name = Column(String, nullable=False)\n    last_name = Column(String, nullable=False)\n    date_of_birth = Column(String)\n    email = Column(String)\n    phone = Column(String)\n    status = Column(String, nullable=False, default=\"active\", check_constraint=CheckConstraint(\"status IN ('active', 'merged', 'deleted')\"))\n    created_at = Column(DATETIME, default=datetime.utcnow)\n    updated_at = Column(DATETIME, default=datetime.utcnow)\n\nclass Document(Base):\n    __tablename__ = \"documents\"\n\n    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True)\n    applicant_id = Column(String, ForeignKey(\"applicants.id\"), nullable=False)\n    file_name = Column(String, nullable=False)\n    file_path = Column(String, nullable=False)\n    file_type = Column(String)\n    file_size = Column(Integer)\n    uploaded_at = Column(DATETIME, default=datetime.utcnow)\n    created_at = Column(DATETIME, default=datetime.utcnow)\n    updated_at = Column(DATETIME, default=datetime.utcnow)\n\nclass TestScore(Base):\n    __tablename__ = \"test_scores\"\n\n    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True)\n    applicant_id = Column(String, ForeignKey(\"applicants.id\"), nullable=False)\n    test_name = Column(String, nullable=False)\n    score = Column(REAL)\n    test_date = Column(String)\n    created_at = Column(DATETIME, default=datetime.utcnow)\n    updated_at = Column(DATETIME, default=datetime.utcnow)\n\nclass RecommendationRequest(Base):\n    __tablename__ = \"recommendation_requests\"\n\n    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True)\n    applicant_id = Column(String, ForeignKey(\"applicants.id\"), nullable=False)\n    recommender_name = Column(String, nullable=False)\n    recommender_email = Column(String, nullable=False)\n    status = Column(String, nullable=False, default=\"pending\", check_constraint=CheckConstraint(\"status IN ('pending', 'submitted', 'declined')\"))\n    requested_at = Column(DATETIME, default=datetime.utcnow)\n    submitted_at = Column(DATETIME)\n    created_at = Column(DATETIME, default=datetime.utcnow)\n    updated_at = Column(DATETIME, default=datetime.utcnow)\n\nclass SubmissionResponse(Base):\n    __tablename__ = \"submission_responses\"\n\n    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True)\n    applicant_id = Column(String, ForeignKey(\"applicants.id\"), nullable=False)\n    question_key = Column(String, nullable=False)\n    response_text = Column(Text)\n    submitted_at = Column(DATETIME, default=datetime.utcnow)\n    created_at = Column(DATETIME, default=datetime.utcnow)\n    updated_at = Column(DATETIME, default=datetime.utcnow)\n\nclass MergeLog(Base):\n    __tablename__ = \"merge_logs\"\n\n    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True)\n    primary_applicant_id = Column(String, ForeignKey(\"applicants.id\"), nullable=False)\n    duplicate_applicant_id = Column(String, ForeignKey(\"applicants.id\"), nullable=False)\n    reviewer_user_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey(\"users.id\"), nullable=False)\n    merged_at = Column(DATETIME, default=datetime.utcnow)\n    details = Column(Text)\n    created_at = Column(DATETIME, default=datetime.utcnow)"

    },
    {
      "path": "routers/group_001.py",
      "content": "from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, status\nfrom sqlalchemy.orm import Session\nfrom datetime import datetime\n\nfrom database import get_db\nfrom models import Applicant, Document, TestScore, RecommendationRequest, SubmissionResponse, MergeLog, User\nfrom schemas import MergeApplicantRecordsResponse, MergeApplicantRecordsRequest\n\nrouter = APIRouter(tags=[\"Applicants\"])\n\n\n@router.post(\n    \"/api/applicants/{primary_applicant_id}/merge-duplicate/{duplicate_applicant_id}\",\n    operation_id=\"merge_applicant_records\",\n    response_model=MergeApplicantRecordsResponse,\n)\nasync def merge_applicant_records(\n    primary_applicant_id: str,\n    duplicate_applicant_id: str,\n    payload: MergeApplicantRecordsRequest,\n    db: Session = Depends(get_db)\n):\n    # Fetch primary and duplicate applicants\n    primary_applicant = db.query(Applicant).filter(Applicant.id == primary_applicant_id).first()\n    duplicate_applicant = db.query(Applicant).filter(Applicant.id == duplicate_applicant_id).first()\n\n    if not primary_applicant:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, detail=\"Primary applicant not found\")\n    if not duplicate_applicant:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, detail=\"Duplicate applicant not found\")\n\n    # Verify both applicants belong to the same program\n    if primary_applicant.program_id != duplicate_applicant.program_id:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST, detail=\"Applicants must belong to the same program\")\n\n    # Check if duplicate applicant is already merged/deleted\n    if duplicate_applicant.status in [\"merged\", \"deleted\"]:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST, detail=\"Duplicate applicant is already merged or deleted\")\n\n    # Get reviewer info\n    reviewer = db.query(User).filter(User.id == payload.reviewer_user_id).first()\n    if not reviewer:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, detail=\"Reviewer user not found\")\n\n    try:\n        # Step 1: Transfer documents\n        docs = db.query(Document).filter(Document.applicant_id == duplicate_applicant_id).all()\n        for doc in docs:\n            doc.applicant_id = primary_applicant_id\n            db.add(doc)\n\n        # Step 2: Transfer test scores\n        test_scores = db.query(TestScore).filter(TestScore.applicant_id == duplicate_applicant_id).all()\n        for ts in test_scores:\n            ts.applicant_id = primary_applicant_id\n            db.add(ts)\n\n        # Step 3: Transfer recommendation requests\n        rec_reqs = db.query(RecommendationRequest).filter(RecommendationRequest.applicant_id == duplicate_applicant_id).all()\n        for req in rec_reqs:\n            req.applicant_id = primary_applicant_id\n            db.add(req)\n\n        # Step 4: Transfer submission responses\n        responses = db.query(SubmissionResponse).filter(SubmissionResponse.applicant_id == duplicate_applicant_id).all()\n        for resp in responses:\n            resp.applicant_id = primary_applicant_id\n            db.add(resp)\n\n        # Step 5: Resolve date_of_birth conflict\n        # Keep the one from primary applicant\n        if primary_applicant.date_of_birth:\n            duplicate_applicant.date_of_birth = primary_applicant.date_of_birth\n\n        # Step 6: Update status of duplicate applicant\n        duplicate_applicant.status = \"merged\"\n        db.add(duplicate_applicant)\n\n        # Step 7: Log the merge\n        merge_log = MergeLog(\n            primary_applicant_id=primary_applicant_id,\n            duplicate_applicant_id=duplicate_applicant_id,\n            reviewer_user_id=payload.reviewer_user_id,\n            merged_at=datetime.utcnow(),\n            details=f\"Merged duplicate applicant {duplicate_applicant_id} into primary applicant {primary_applicant_id}\"\n        )\n        db.add(merge_log)\n\n        # Commit all changes\n        db.commit()\n\n        return MergeApplicantRecordsResponse(\n            message=\"Applicant records successfully merged\",\n            merged_at=merge_log.merged_at,\n            primary_applicant_id=primary_applicant_id,\n            duplicate_applicant_id=duplicate_applicant_id\n        )\n\n    except Exception as e:\n        db.rollback()\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_500_INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR, detail=str(e))\n    finally:\n        db.close()"
    }
